summary: Iter 79 backend + frontend testing of Body Temple 28 ($39 course), Grace Boundaries Mode, and Parent opt-out toggle regression. 19/19 backend pytest tests pass after correcting two endpoint paths in the test (review-spec listed /api/kids/curriculum/modules and /api/referral/onboard; actual routes are /api/kids-curriculum/modules and /api/referral/claim — endpoints themselves are healthy). Frontend: /body-temple renders house-cream bg with wooden week cards + 28 day chips + Aurin avatar+golden aura; Day 1 modal shows full free practice with AURIN ASKS reflection; Day 5 public shows locked teaser + 'Unlock Body Temple 28 — $39' CTA; Day 5 authed shows full practice + 'Mark this day walked' button. Parent opt-out toggle on /parent-portal/wellness flips correctly between 'Active · pause' ↔ 'Paused · resume' (3 toggle cycles verified). /body-room shows wooden Body Temple entry card linking to /body-temple. /clarity-release loads at Threshold gate as designed — GraceModeSelector only rendered after the 4-quiet-truths gate is cleared (out of scope for automation without checkbox-by-checkbox walk-through). Code review confirms GraceModeSelector is correctly imported and wired in ClarityRelease.jsx for PHASES.HUB.

minor.issue: Response shape uses top-level 'unlocked' flag plus nested 'day.is_premium' rather than a 'locked' boolean. Review-request spec used 'locked' — actual contract is fine and consistent, but doc-vs-code drift could confuse future agents.

integration_issues.issue: Could not be observed live in automation because the test user's progression on /clarity-release is at the Threshold/Gate phase (PHASES.GATE), not Hub. GraceModeSelector renders only inside PHASES.HUB block (ClarityRelease.jsx:~471). To observe the selector live, an automated test would need to either click each of the 4 quiet-truths checkboxes + continue, or expose a gate-bypass localStorage key for testing. Backend API for grace/modes + grace/mode is fully verified (4/4 grace tests pass) including persistence + clearing + unknown-mode 400 rejection.

action_items: Optional: add a documented gate-bypass mechanism (e.g., a localStorage key `clarity_gate_bypass_dev=1` or query flag `?phase=hub`) so testing agents can observe GraceModeSelector live without walking the 4 truths every iteration. The current Threshold→Hub flow is correct for users but blocks automated UI verification of every Hub-only widget (same limitation flagged in iter 77 + iter 78 for UniversalMinuteBank + TodaysQuestCard).
Optional: align review-spec endpoint paths with code — /api/kids-curriculum/modules (hyphen, not slash) and /api/referral/claim (not /onboard). Both endpoints work; only doc/spec drift.

Optional: consider returning a 'locked' boolean alongside 'unlocked' in /api/body-temple/day/{n} response so the API contract is self-evident (currently consumers must compute locked = !unlocked && day.is_premium).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~14.7k lines after iter 79 added Body Temple + Grace endpoints (lines 3428-3640). Recommend extracting to backend/body_temple.py (curriculum already lives in body_temple_curriculum.py — pair the endpoints with it) and backend/grace_modes.py to keep server.py under control.

BodyTemple.jsx 'Mark this day walked' button uses data-testid='body-temple-day-complete-btn' which is fine, but the review-request expected 'body-temple-mark-walked' — naming drift between spec and code. Stick with the actual id but document it.

Body Temple Day teaser for locked premium days (day 5+) hardcodes a single fallback string 'A gentle practice inside Body Temple 28. Unlock the course to walk this day with Aurin.' — consider per-week teaser blurbs for richer curiosity (Touch/Rest/Presence have different vibes).

GraceModeSelector renders only at PHASES.HUB which is correct, but combined with the 4-truths gate it makes the feature effectively invisible to first-time visitors. Worth adding an analytics event when the user first reaches Hub so growth can measure how many users see/use mode selection.
